column1: # retired-rules.tsv: rules forge-kit retired, one row per retired phrasing (#495).
# Read by stale-rules.sh beside it. Tab separated, five columns:
#   id, version retired, date retired, extended regex of the retired phrasing, replacement summary.
# The regex is matched case-insensitively against a paragraph whose whitespace is collapsed, so a
# phrase wrapped across lines still matches. Write it in lowercase, ERE as awk reads it. It finds
# the listed phrasings only, never a paraphrase: add a row when a new wording turns up.
# The kit current version of each id is not here: it is the rule id comment beside the canonical
# text in the kit, which scripts/check-review-rule.sh keeps above every version listed here.
